result.brief: 研究隐线性动态非平稳赌博机中的分块乐观算法，将遗憾界从 O(T^{2/3}) 改进到 O(√T)，属理论强化学习范畴，与视频/世界模型生成无直接关联。
result.reason: Bandit regret theory with latent linear dynamics; no video, world-model generation, audio-video, or multimodal generation evidence. Latent state is a bandit construct, not a generative world model.
